name: Florida
licensingAuthorityNote: Florida trade licenses are issued by the Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR); healthcare licenses go through the Department of Health.

faqs.question: Does Florida accept the NASCLA exam for contractors?
faqs.answer: Yes, Florida is one of the states that accepts the NASCLA Accredited Examination for Commercial General Building Contractors in place of its own trade exam for qualifying applicants.
